categories.main_business_segments: Sunlour Pigment Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the pigment manufacturing industry, focusing on phthalocyanine series pigments, chromium-based pigments, pigment violet, and copper phthalocyanine. The company is engaged in the production and sales of fine chemical pigments used in inks, coatings, plastics, textiles, and other applications. It also operates a subsidiary, Sunlour Pigment Taixing Co., Ltd., which produces similar pigment products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs mature mass production technologies for phthalocyanine pigments, chromium pigments, pigment violet, and copper phthalocyanine. It utilizes solvent-based synthesis methods, surface modification, dispersion enhancement, and environmentally friendly processes. The company has proprietary technologies and patents related to pigment synthesis, drying, and surface treatment, supported by its provincial enterprise technology centers and collaborations with academic institutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Sunlour serves over 1,600 customers, including well-known domestic and international companies in the ink, coating, and plastic industries. Its pigments are used in applications such as solvent-based inks, automotive coatings, textile fiber coloring, and specialty inks. The company targets both general and specialized high-performance pigment markets, focusing on environmentally friendly and high-value-added products.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates within China, with domestic sales accounting for over 95% of revenue. It also has a growing international presence, with exports contributing nearly 5% of sales. The company has established sales offices covering major pigment consumption markets across China and participates in international exhibitions to expand its global footprint.
categories.supply_chain_position: Sunlour operates mainly in the midstream segment of the pigment supply chain, manufacturing pigment raw materials and intermediate products. It extends upstream by controlling key raw materials to ensure quality and cost control and serves downstream industries such as ink, coatings, plastics, and textiles by providing customized pigment solutions.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technological innovation and green development, focusing on developing high-performance, environmentally friendly pigments. R&D priorities include high-gloss, low-viscosity phthalocyanine blue, composite pigment reds, and advanced wastewater treatment technologies. It invests in digitalization, intelligent manufacturing, and process optimization to enhance product quality and operational efficiency while complying with stricter environmental standards.
categories.revenue_model: Sunlour generates revenue primarily through direct sales of pigment products to industrial customers. The company operates a direct sales model without intermediaries, focusing on product sales in domestic and international markets. Revenue is derived from the sale of various pigment types, including phthalocyanine pigments, chromium pigments, pigment violet, and copper phthalocyanine.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Sunlour is positioned as one of the leading domestic manufacturers in the phthalocyanine and chromium pigment segments, recognized for its strong R&D capabilities and product quality. The pigment industry in China is fragmented with many small players, but Sunlour benefits from scale, technology, and environmental compliance advantages. It actively participates in national and industry standard-setting, enhancing its competitive positioning.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Sunlour reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.575 billion, representing a 9.9% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose significantly by 155.3% to about RMB 120.7 million. The company maintains a stable asset base of around RMB 1.85 billion and continues to invest in R&D, with expenditures increasing to nearly RMB 70 million, reflecting a growth-oriented and innovation-driven profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sunlour differentiates itself through advanced production processes, environmental sustainability, and customized pigment solutions tailored to specific customer needs. Its products offer superior quality, stability, and environmental compliance, supported by proprietary technologies and patents. The company’s commitment to green manufacturing, digital transformation, and participation in industry standards enhances its brand reputation and customer trust.
